pdf.fileName: SAGA EDITION - Starships of the Galaxy.pdf

entries.reviewFinding: Six detachable Dreadnaughts encircle a central core, but the printed Outbound Flight profile is one unique Colossal (station) capital ship. Fifteen turbolaser, three laser, and five quad-laser batteries are attack-group counts, not barrel or arc certificates.

sourceObservations.observation: Six Dreadnaught-class ships joined by metal tethers around central fusion core; composite printed as one ship
15 turbolaser batteries +15; 3 laser cannon batteries +13; 5 quad laser cannon batteries +15
Each Dreadnaught can detach to operate on its own; detached form not independently statted here

entries.reviewFinding: Vulture has a published walker movement mode in addition to starship flight, no organic crew, and two separate AND attack groups. Droid control/virtual gunners cannot be converted to physical stations or extra gun barrels.

sourceObservations.observation: Huge starfighter/ground vehicle walker; walker 6 squares alongside fly movement
Laser cannons +7 AND medium concussion missiles +7; six missiles carried
Crew 0 computerized droid starfighter can operate its weapons as though each has a dedicated gunner; virtual not human crew

entries.reviewFinding: Scarab statblock lists only blaster cannons. No missile payload is published, and nearby Vulture/Tri-Fighter ammunition and droid stats must not be inherited.

sourceObservations.observation: One blaster-cannon attack family +4, autofire -1
No Payload line or missile attack on Scarab statblock
Shared droid starfighter prose gives droid-control context, without source proof of separate stock hardware

entries.reviewFinding: The central singular laser cannon and three light laser cannons have explicit distinct hardware counts; missile payload of six is ammunition, not launcher count. Keep crew 0 virtual operating authority separate.

sourceObservations.observation: One laser cannon +7 AND three light laser cannons +7
Medium concussion missiles +7, payload six missiles
Printed Crew 0, independent droid weapon operation; no physical gunners

entries.reviewFinding: The stock Dynamic freighter has one printed double-laser attack family and lacks shields. Deck plan turret access is internal ship layout, not evidence of gun count, turret azimuth or firing arc.

sourceObservations.observation: Double laser cannons +3 (gunner), 4d10x2
+2 circumstance on Mechanics checks to repair or modify this ship, not all Mechanics checks
Deck plan includes Turret Access; no explicit physical cannon count or arc

entries.printedName: Kuat Systems Engineering Eta-2 Actis Interceptor
entries.reviewFinding: Stock Eta-2 attacks are laser cannons OR ion cannons; missiles are rare substitution for ions, not extra default stock weapons. Booster-ring x1 and astromech skill/cover adjustments remain conditional.

sourceObservations.observation: Laser cannons +14 OR ion cannons +14, both pilot-operated
Crew one plus astromech; distinct astromech sensor/skill/cover values
Booster-ring x1 hyperdrive; some rare craft replace ions with concussion missile launcher

entries.printedName: FreiTek Inc. E-wing Starfighter, Type B
entries.reviewFinding: Type B prints triple heavy blaster cannons and sixteen torpedoes with fire-link. The printed 'triple' designation and torpedo count do not by themselves prove discrete independent mount counts or arcs. R7 astromech bonus is conditional.

sourceObservations.observation: Triple heavy blaster cannons +10 OR proton torpedoes +10
R7 or sufficiently modified astromech gives pilot +2 equipment bonus to Pilot checks
16 proton torpedoes; quantity is ammunition, not launcher count

entries.printedName: Kuat Systems Engineering Firespray-31 Patrol Craft
entries.reviewFinding: Narrative independently confirms stock Firespray pair of blaster cannons; tractor-beam count remains unspecified. Three unused emplacement points are modification capacity, not installed guns; Slave I is a distinct named modification.

sourceObservations.observation: Stock pair of blaster cannons and powerful tractor beam
Three unused emplacement points on stock Firespray
Slave I modified separately from production-model stock Firespray

sourceLedgerRow.hardwareCountBasis: p84 narrative: a pair of blaster cannons

entries.reviewFinding: PDF weapon table explicitly prints concussion mine damage 8d10x2, but CP16 attack-group row recorded 10d10x2. Preserve the original ledger and stage a correction to 8d10x2. Tracking-beacon torpedoes deal Special effect, not conventional explosive damage.

sourceObservations.observation: Concussion mines (pilot): Atk +18, Dmg 8d10x2
CP16 concussion mine damage stored 10d10x2
Proton torpedoes: Dmg Special (proton beacon), +5 Use Computer checks to locate escaped tracked target
Gargantuan starfighter treatment only for capital-weapon targeting, dogfighting, and maneuvers

entries.reviewFinding: The Geonosian Nantex's micro-tractor emitters provide +1 on close-range laser attack rolls, not a separate tractor-beam attack or an additional physical mount. Species-tailored avionics and extreme-speed narrative are not stock movement replacements.

sourceObservations.observation: Laser cannons +6 (pilot), no standalone tractor attack row
Within two squares of target gain +1 equipment bonus on attack rolls from micro-tractor emitters
Geonosian physiological controls; no ordinary non-Geonosian operation

entries.printedName: Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective Ginivex-class Starfighter
entries.reviewFinding: Solar sail deploys +15 SR above normal 30, yielding SR45, loses the bonus upon retraction; the sail is not another weapon. One double-laser family with unsupported barrel count and arcs.

sourceObservations.observation: Deploying sail increases SR from 30 to 45; retracting immediately removes extra 15 SR
Double laser cannons +11, pilot operated, damage 6d10x2
Hyperdrive x1 with limited five-jump navcomputer

entries.reviewFinding: Stock Gozanti has two laser-cannon batteries and two quad-laser-cannon batteries, plus proton torpedoes. Neither battery count nor crew implies barrels. Krayt's Honor is an individually modified vessel, not a baseline replacement.

sourceObservations.observation: Proton torpedoes +4 AND 2 laser cannon batteries +8 AND 2 quad laser cannon batteries +4
Eight proton torpedoes, 12 normal-quality crew
Krayt's Honor independently modifies Gozanti loadout and defenses

entries.reviewFinding: Krayt's Honor has a second proton-torpedo launcher and three added turbolasers explicitly in the printed prose. Captain's trained-pilot +2 is already included, so no double bonus. Modified batteries must not become generic Gozanti stock.

sourceObservations.observation: Second proton torpedo launcher, two launchers fire-linked
Three new turbolasers added, one printed three-gunner battery
Captain's +2 trained Pilot bonus already included in attack statistics

sourceLedgerRow.hardwareCountBasis: p91 capability narrative: second proton-torpedo launcher added to the stock launcher
sourceLedgerRow.fireLink: printed narrative; damage already includes pilot bonus

sourceLedgerRow.hardwareCountBasis: p91 narrative explicitly says addition of THREE turbolasers

entries.reviewFinding: Eight double turbolasers individually operated; cannot fire as a battery. Separate point-defense battery and heavy concussion missiles. Four missile attack declarations are not a launcher count, and payload 120 remains ammunition.

sourceObservations.observation: Eight double turbolasers with independent gunners; cannot fire as batteries
4 heavy concussion missiles in Ranged summary versus 120 carried payload
Standard action forgo attacks: adjacent allied ships +1 Reflex, enemies -1 Reflex

sourceLedgerRow.hardwareCountBasis: p92 Ranged line: 8 double turbolasers; each independently controlled

entries.reviewFinding: Ranged line explicitly lists FOUR mass-pulse tubes without attack roll, but CP16 lists physical hardwareCount as source-silent. Propose p93-sourced count 4 only for those tubes. Sixteen mines are payload, with 4-square interdiction radius for 10 minutes; rotating tracks do not provide firing arcs.

sourceObservations.observation: 4 mass pulse tubes (no attack roll)
16 pulse mass mines carried; each creates 4-square-radius 10-minute hyperspace denial
Older design has single-target limits (-10 multiple targets) and 3-round turbolaser recharge; updated later
Rotating tracks described but arcs per mounted weapon not printed
